verdict.rationale: Versioning automations is a fair question for a payments platform, since such platforms can offer configurable automated workflows. The evidence covers only the payments API, test/live keys, recurring payments, transfers and dashboard exports, with nothing on versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations. Test versus live environments separate environments rather than versioning automations, and recurring payments are a billing feature, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
